feeds.title: Sensory Sid Blog
feeds.description: Join us on Sid's Blog to learn about sensory processing disorder and sensory diets. Sensory Sid was started by Katie and Kara who wanted to create something that was effective, fun, and easy to use with the goal of allowing all children to reach their highest potential by helping improve their sensory regulation.

feeds.title: CoordiKids Blog
feeds.description: Our blogs contain the most up to date information on all topics related to sensory processing disorders and kids with learning difficulties. Marga and Louis Grey, Founders of CoordiKids, have a passion to help children overcome struggles in different spheres of their lives. CoordiKids was born from a desire to help more, to serve more, and to make effective intervention easy and affordable for as many children as possible.

feeds.title: Attitude » Sensory Processing Disorder
feeds.description: Sensory processing disorder is a neurological condition that makes individuals' senses uncomfortably heightened, causing them to feel overwhelmed and stressed. Learn more about the symptoms through our blog. ADDitude Magazine is the nation's leading source of important news, expert advice, and judgment-free understanding for families and adults living with attention deficit disorder.

feeds.title: Sensory Processing Disorder Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find the latest updates, additions, news and tidbits on Sensory Processing Disorder. The Sensory Processing Disorder website is a resource center for anyone seeking information on SPD and its signs and symptoms.

feeds.title: The Sensory Spectrum
feeds.description: The Sensory Spectrum is an online community for Sensory Processing Disorder kids and their parents. Jennifer, a mom of 2 boys with SPD, started this website as a communal space to post links to research information, news coverage, etc. She also posts updates of her blog, book references and product ideas.

feeds.title: Molly Fuller Design Blog
feeds.description: Learn about SPD and ASD and how you can help your child with our tips. Molly Fuller Design makes stylish sensory friendly clothing for teens and adults with autism spectrum disorder and sensory processing disorder. She majored in fashion design in college with the goal of making better clothing that served a medical purpose.

feeds.title: CSLOT » Sensory Processing
feeds.description: Our blog provides tips and information on how to help and care for a child with sensory processing disorder. CSLOT is a complete diagnostic and therapeutic center for disorders of communication, movement, sensory, behavior, and accented English.

feeds.title: Dove Rehab Services Blog
feeds.description: Dove Rehab Services helps to maximize your child's potential and our blog provides the necessary information on Sensory Processing Disorder. We are a small Occupational Therapy private practice that serves children who have minimal to moderate sensory integration disorders.

feeds.title: Sensory Smart Parent Blog
feeds.description: The Sensory Smart Parent blog gives advice on how to care for a child with Sensory Processing Disorder. Nancy Peske, a passionate educator on sensory issues has been active in the SPD community since 2002, presenting to parents and professionals eager to learn practical ways to help kids with sensory processing issues.

feeds.title: Sensational Achievements » Sensory Integration
feeds.description: Read about current evidence based research and trending topics and issues related to sensory integration. Sensational Achievements is giving power to people with different abilities in a digital world.

feeds.title: Sensory Processing Explained Blog
feeds.description: Our blog provides accessible and understandable Sensory Resources for parents and educators. Heather Greutman and Sharla Kostelyk are co-authors of Sensory Processing Explained where they provide you with the tools and strategies needed for all things sensory.

feeds.title: Thera Play LA Blog
feeds.description: Learn about sensory integration, problem solving, handwriting, and more areas that can be assessed and addressed by pediatric occupational therapy. With Dr. Marielly and her team at Theraplay LA, whether your child is dealing with challenges big or small, they have the training and years of experience to create advanced treatments for them.

feeds.title: Sensational Development Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts by the staff at Sensational Development. We post information and topics of interest for our clients. We are dedicated to meeting the unique needs of our children and families in order to facilitate optimal development and participation in daily activities.

feeds.title: Developmental Pathways for Kids Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about pediatric therapy, integrated playgroups, sensory processing, and more from our collection of well-studied blogs. At Developmental Pathways for Kids, the therapists carefully analyze each therapy session to facilitate sensory-motor skill development, social communication, and build play skills.

feeds.title: Sensory Health Coach Blog
feeds.description: Our blogs helps you with information and strategies to manage your child's SPD and their special needs. Hi, I'm Anne Laure Jackson, and I will work with you to identify your unique sensory thumbprint that holds the key to sensory health and wellbeing.
